name: Steal for the Depths
text:
Requirements You are swimming in water at least 10 feet deep.

---
You reach out and grab an adjacent creature (on nearby land or in the water) and pull it below the surface. Attempt an Athletics check to grapple the creature. On a success, if the creature is on land, in addition to the normal effects of Grapple, you pull the creature into the water in a space adjacent to you. If the creature is already in the water, on a success, in addition the normal effects of Grapple, you drag the creature 10 feet deeper into the water, moving 10 feet with the creature. Moving a creature into water or deeper into water using steal for the Depths is forced movement for the creature but not for you.
